description: This source file defines an abstract class 'TypeSpec' and multiple derived classes representing different type specifications used within the Orleans serialization system, such as pointer types, reference types, arrays, generics, named types, assembly-qualified types, tuples, and literals.

classes.name: TypeSpec
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a type within the Orleans serialization type system, with an abstract method 'Format' to produce a parseable string representation.

classes.name: PointerTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a pointer (*) type, wrapping an element type derived from TypeSpec.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a reference (&) type, wrapping an element type derived from TypeSpec.

classes.name: ArrayTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents an array type with specified element type and dimensions.

classes.name: ConstructedGenericTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a constructed generic type with an unconstructed base type and type arguments.

classes.name: NamedTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a named type, possibly nested, with support for namespace and generic arity.

classes.name: AssemblyQualifiedTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a type with an associated assembly qualification.

classes.name: TupleTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a tuple type, with support for generic arity and elements.

classes.name: LiteralTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a literal string value type.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Abstract method to produce a string representation of the type specification, suitable for parsing.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the type, overriding Object.ToString().

methods.name: GetNamespaceQualifiedName
methods.description: Constructs the namespace-qualified name of a potentially nested type, including containing types.
